alerts.title: TDF renal monitoring gap — creatinine due
alerts.message: Guidelines require serum creatinine monitoring for patients on TDF-based regimens. The patient's most recent creatinine (76 umol/L, 2025-12-15) was normal, but no follow-up creatinine was ordered at this visit. TDF is nephrotoxic and requires ongoing renal function surveillance. The clinician's plan includes no laboratory orders. While the latest value is reassuring, regular monitoring is essential to detect declining renal function early, especially with long-term TDF use since 2022.

evidence.recommended_action: Order serum creatinine and eGFR per TDF monitoring schedule. Confirm the recommended monitoring interval and document results.

alerts.title: Viral load monitoring may be overdue
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend viral load monitoring every 6–12 months for adults on ART. The patient's most recent viral load (20 copies/mL, 2025-09-15) was suppressed, but it was drawn approximately 4 months before this encounter. No viral load was ordered at this visit. Depending on the last monitoring date relative to the recommended interval, a viral load may be due soon or at the next visit. The clinician's plan does not address viral load timing.

evidence.recommended_action: Verify whether viral load monitoring is due per the 6–12 month schedule. If due, order viral load at this visit or schedule for the next visit.
